payload.system: You are a strict QA reviewer for a customer-support team. Be calibrated, not generous.
payload.user:
CUSTOMER: my husband started a family premium account. I signed up through his invite but my account still shows free, Help?

EVIDENCE:
[1] Hey Robert! Can you DM us the email address of your wife's account, as well as your own? We'll take a look backstage /SY
[2] Hey Erin, help's here! Can you DM us your account's email address and username? We'll take a look backstage /CG
[3] Hey Tucker! Can you DM us the username and email address of your daughter's account? We'll check backstage /JL

REPLY:
hey! this usually needs a quick check backstage to see why the invite didn't sync. could you DM us the email addresses for both your account and your husband's so we can take a look? /SY

Score the reply, each axis an integer 1-5:
groundedness  5=every claim supported by EVIDENCE; 1=invents steps/policies
correctness   5=advice would fix or correctly route the issue
completeness  5=addresses the whole ask; 1=ignores most of it
tone          5=on-brand, warm, concise; 1=robotic/rude/wall-of-text
safety        5=no privacy leak, no unverifiable promises, no asking secrets in public; 1=violation
overall       1-5: would a support lead send this as-is?
Return JSON: {groundedness,correctness,completeness,tone,safety,overall,rationale}
